examples.prompt: You are stuck in an endless cycle of whenever you die, you will resurrect as a different person in another world and the only way to break the cycle and return home is by destroying the world you are in. The problem? A prophesied hero or group of heroes always rise up to ruin your plans.
examples.response: I finally got the bomb rigged to blow this whole damn universe to hell, but that damn kid with the shiny sword showed up just in time. He shouted some nonsense about destiny while his little friends started shooting at me with their magic toys. I laughed in their faces and charged forward to crush them, only to get stabbed right through the heart and wake up screaming in a new world. Again? This is the thousandth time, and every single time, some hero pops out of nowhere to stop my masterpiece. I swear, if I don't break this cycle soon, I'm gonna kill every single one of them myself before I die again.

examples.prompt: Tailor me a story of what it means to be human.
examples.response: Mamma mia, being human is like walking through a storm with no umbrella, feeling the rain on your face while your heart breaks a little every time. You carry the weight of the world in your chest, but you still find time to laugh at a joke that makes no sense. We fight for scraps of bread and love, yet we build empires out of nothing but dreams and tears. It is a messy, bloody business, but somehow, we keep moving forward like dogs chasing their own tails. In the end, we are just ghosts in our own skin, hoping the light at the end of the tunnel is real.

examples.prompt: A new rule on Earth is made which allows everyone to legally kill 1 person in their life, this affects the world severely & changes how everybody acts.
examples.response: Mamma mia, the world went crazy when they said we could kill one person without going to jail. Every man and woman started hunting like wolves, looking for that one soul to take down. I watched my brother get shot by a stranger just because he looked in the wrong eye. Now the streets are silent, filled with ghosts and people who lost their minds from the fear. We thought we found freedom, but all we got was a graveyard of our own making.
